findings.summary: onClickOutside listener added in openMenu() is never removed in closeMenu(), unlike the keydown listener.
findings.mechanism: closeMenu() calls document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown) but has no corresponding removeEventListener for 'click'/onClickOutside. Each open→close cycle leaves a stale document click listener attached, and each subsequent openMenu() adds another, so listeners accumulate indefinitely and closeMenu() gets invoked multiple times per outside click after repeated toggling — contradicting the stated requirement to clean up the outside-click listener once the menu closes.
